newsitem.title: USA: Cytec completes $88 mln sale of fibers unit.
newsitem.headline: Cytec completes $88 mln sale of fibers unit.

text.p: Cytec Industries Inc Friday said it has completed the sale of its acrylic fibers business to a subsidiary of Sterling Chemicals Inc of Houston.

Cytec said it received about $88 million in cash, and received other considerations, including the assumption by Sterling of certain contingent and other liabilities, with a value of about $15 million.
The assets transferred to Sterling include Cytec's plant located near Pensacola, Florida, where most of the employees in the business are located, Cytec said.
Cytec's acrylic fibers business had sales of approximately $140 million in 1996. Cytec will continue to supply acrylonitrile to the business through a long-term supply agreement.
